Vicky Kaushal Birthday 2026: 5 Best Performances That Every Fan Should See
On Vicky Kaushal’s 38th birthday, revisit his five best performances from 'Uri' and 'Sardar Udham' to 'Chhaava' and 'Sam Bahadur' that proved his versatility and powerhouse acting talent.
Team BTMay 16, 2026, 07:00 IST

​Vicky Kaushal will celebrate his 38th birthday on May 16 this year. It’s been 10 years since he marked his Bollywood debut and his popularity has only grown in leaps and bounds with every powerful performance and blockbuster success. From Uri: The Surgical Strike that marked his entry as a ‘Bollywood hero’ to Chhaava where he witnessed enormous box office success, Kaushal’s career trajectory has only seen highs with a very few lows. To celebrate the actor on his special day, here’s recalling five of his best performances to date.

‘Chhaava’ (2025)

Chhaava is a grand historical drama that brings the story of Chhatrapati Sambhaji Maharaj to the big screen with scale, emotion, and intense action. Directed by Laxman Utekar, the film blends powerful battle sequences with emotional moments rooted in Maratha history. Vicky Kaushal earned widespread praise for his commanding performance. Critics and audiences particularly appreciated his fierce on-screen presence.

‘Uri: The Surgical Strike’ (2019)

Uri: The Surgical Strike is one of the most impactful military dramas in recent Bollywood history, inspired by the 2016 Uri surgical strikes. Directed by Aditya Dhar, the film stood out for its gripping narrative and high-octane action sequences. Vicky Kaushal delivered a career-defining performance, bringing both emotional vulnerability and fierce determination to the role.

‘Sardar Udham’ (2021)

It’s a powerful biographical drama that chronicles the life of revolutionary freedom fighter Udham Singh and his quest for justice after the Jallianwala Bagh massacre. Vicky Kaushal delivered one of the finest performances of his career, portraying Udham Singh with remarkable intensity and quiet resilience.

‘Sam Bahadur’ (2023)

It’s a biopic based on the life of India’s first Field Marshal, Sam Manekshaw. Directed by Meghna Gulzar, the film traces Manekshaw’s remarkable military journey during the 1971 Indo-Pak war, and his sharp wit and fearless personality. Vicky Kaushal received widespread acclaim for completely transforming into the legendary officer, perfectly capturing his body language, voice, and charismatic presence.

‘Sanju’ (2018)

It’s a biographical drama inspired by the turbulent life of Sanjay Dutt, directed by Rajkumar Hirani. While Ranbir Kapoor led the film, Vicky Kaushal also left a lasting impression in a supporting role as Kamlesh, Sanju’s loyal best friend. Kaushal brought warmth, humour, and emotional depth to the character, making the friendship one of the film’s strongest emotional anchors.

Happy Birthday, Vicky Kaushal!
